_comment: Local, offline threat-intel feed used when no live API key is configured. Addresses are deliberately drawn from the IANA documentation ranges (RFC 5737: 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) so nothing here could be mistaken for a real-world address. Add your own entries, or point the app at a live feed via ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY.
